input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: We searched the whole agreement (including §§ 12, 26 and 30, where a non-solicit is usually bundled) for "solicit", "induce", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "recruit", "employee" and "personnel". No provision anywhere restricts Customer from soliciting, hiring or engaging Vendor personnel; the only personnel-related terms allocate Vendor's responsibility for its own staff (§ 30.1) and confidentiality access (§ 16.2). § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer may hire any person responding to general recruitment and has given no no-hire commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicitation restriction on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
